# AI crawler reference

The 17 AI crawler user-agents GTM Toolkit recognises, grouped into training, search and user-triggered, and how to allow or block each group.

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-docs.mjs from `gtm reference`. Do not edit by hand. -->

The 17 AI crawlers GTM Toolkit 2.0.0 knows by name, grouped by what they collect pages for.

A purpose set to `disallow` puts every agent in that group under one `Disallow: /` block in `robots.txt`. Agents in an allowed group get no block of their own and follow the rules for `*`.

## Training

Collect pages to train models. Controlled by `crawlers.ai.training`.

| User-agent | Operator |
| --- | --- |
| `GPTBot` | OpenAI |
| `ClaudeBot` | Anthropic |
| `Google-Extended` | Google |
| `Applebot-Extended` | Apple |
| `CCBot` | Common Crawl |
| `Bytespider` | ByteDance |
| `meta-externalagent` | Meta |
| `Amazonbot` | Amazon |

## Search

Build the index an AI search product answers from. Controlled by `crawlers.ai.search`.

| User-agent | Operator |
| --- | --- |
| `OAI-SearchBot` | OpenAI |
| `Claude-SearchBot` | Anthropic |
| `PerplexityBot` | Perplexity |
| `DuckAssistBot` | DuckDuckGo |

## User-triggered

Fetch one page because a person asked an assistant about it. Controlled by `crawlers.ai.user`.

| User-agent | Operator |
| --- | --- |
| `ChatGPT-User` | OpenAI |
| `Claude-User` | Anthropic |
| `Perplexity-User` | Perplexity |
| `meta-externalfetcher` | Meta |
| `MistralAI-User` | Mistral |

## Agents not on this list

Name any user-agent under `crawlers.agents` to set its policy, whether or not the toolkit has heard of it:

```yaml
crawlers:
  agents:
    SomeNewBot: disallow
    GPTBot: allow        # overrides crawlers.ai.training for this one agent
```

`robots.txt` is a request. Reputable crawlers honour it, but operators say user-triggered fetchers may not, and it is not access control.
